claim: SAGA modes achieve the drug likeness and activity sweet spot in antibiotic design, whereas baselines struggle to balance biological objectives.
falsifier: One could test whether SAGA outperforms baselines in other drug design tasks with similar multi-objective requirements.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the antibiotic design task and the specific baselines compared; transferability to other drug design tasks is unestablished.

title: SAGA multi-agent system for Achieving the drug likeness
